preconditions.description: N is a positive integer within the range of 1 to 20.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of strings.
Each string in the output list consists of digits 0 and 1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in output)
postconditions.description: Each string in the output list has a length of N.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count('1') >= s.count('0') for s in output)
postconditions.description: Each string in the output list has more 1's than 0's in any prefix.
The output list is sorted in decreasing order.
